purpose: Machine-readable plumbing design/checking rules derived from code structure and publicly accessible code information.

rules.condition: Roof/storm drainage sizing is performed without the applicable rainfall intensity/design data.
rules.action: Require project rainfall/design criteria and code storm-sizing method.
rules.source_note: Chapter 11 includes roof drains and sizing of conductors, leaders and storm drains.

rules.condition: Secondary/emergency roof drainage is required by the design but is absent or not independently checked.
rules.action: Check secondary drainage provisions where applicable.
